text:
people-ops: quick check for onboarding: contractors' device policy + KMS + phishing sim timing. Noah starts Mon.

noah: Hey folks, i'm Noah (contractor). Do I need a company laptop or can i use my MacBook Pro? Also when is the security training scheduled?

it-support-bot: Automated: Please enroll devices here: https://intranet/redwood/device-enroll. MDM and disk encryption required for network & infra access.

jessica (IT): @noah we usually provide loaners for engagements >2 weeks. If you prefer personal device, required: Jamf + FileVault enabled + company VPN + certs. Shipping is possible if you reply with "ship" + address.

samir: Also wondering about KMS access for short-term contractors. Last time my contractor waited due to missing approvals.

maria (security): Short version: contractors get time-bound IAM roles. To get KMS access submit a security ticket with: person, role/repo, resources, duration, approving manager. Approvals: manager + security. Expected review time 24-48h.

noah: can someone paste the ticket template so i can open it asap?

jessica (IT): Copy this:
Subject: KMS access request - Noah Nguyen (contractor)
Body:
- Person: Noah Nguyen (contractor)
- Repo/Service: inference-eval
- Resources: kms://proj/rcv-key
- Duration: 14 days
- Justification: perf/quant tests
- Approving manager: Samir Patel
Attach: ID + device enrollment confirmation.

maria (security): Note: complete the security "Foundations" course before infra access. Phishing sim enrollment is mandatory; it runs for new joiners in week 1. Link: https://learn/redwood/security-newhire

people-ops: Jessica, can you ship a loaner if Noah confirms? @noah reply "ship" + address to request.

noah: ship 47 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94103

jessica (IT): Got it. I'll create device & KMS request and ping when shipped. ETA 2 business days.

maria (security): We'll mark the KMS request CONTRACTOR to fast-track and set role TTL = 14 days. Reminder: enable 2FA and register your device in Okta before access granted.

samir: I'll approve once the ticket shows up. Welcome aboard Noah!

people-ops: We'll follow up day 2 to confirm training complete and device enrolled. DM people-ops or @jessica if anything blocks.
